name: Iri Vale
title: Relay dispatcher
dialogue: Runner, over here. Six families through the gate, and Nella’s kitchen has no water. We can change that. I will keep the directions simple.

name: Sera Quill
title: Memory witness
dialogue: The kitchen’s shutoff notice says the donors owe money. I want the original record, and I want those people fed. We can preserve evidence without leaving them in the queue.

name: Bram Cinder
title: Foundry steward
dialogue: Kitchen pump is sound. Lock on the feed is not. We will get the water running, warm the benches, and leave a job sheet the next shift can use.

name: Ves of the Quiet
title: Null Choir listener
dialogue: Take a breath. You have a place here. The kitchen has lost its water, and its warning was never heard. Let us help, one step at a time.

name: Oru
title: Lineage archivist
dialogue: Tell me the name you use now. Your contact is helping Nella reopen the kitchen. Take your welcome record along; we can make this city greet you properly on the same trip.

name: Patch
title: Street quartermaster
dialogue: Medkits on the left, coils on the right. Bring the old casing back if it isn't fused. I can knock something off the next repair.

name: Mara Venn
title: Fen pump delegate
dialogue: The well dropped another handspan. My father's buying water from the pump I work. Check the gauge; I need the number before tonight's shift meeting.

name: Tovin Ash
title: Cinderwood cutter
dialogue: That stand behind me is still alive. The ledger says it's salvage. Check the entry before they send another cutting crew.

name: Ada Silt
title: Steppe kiln keeper
dialogue: My partner's shell is cracked. There's enough mineral below the well to replace it. Read the soil core before you tell me to dig.

name: Ilex Marr
title: Brine culture keeper
dialogue: Don't open the jars. The cultures inside are stable. The stuff on the houses isn't. If you're staying, help me mark the new boundary.

name: Nella Rook
title: Commons kitchen keeper
dialogue: Fourteen bowls stayed empty yesterday. I kept them here. Bring the water back, then help me find the people who could not afford to come.

name: Elin Voss
title: Glass Steps cooling steward
dialogue: A cooling failure makes the clinics choose which memories stay readable. Elin suspects the priority list ranks a person's remaining payments above their wishes.

name: Merek Tan
title: Copper Walk repair delegate
dialogue: An unfinished heat line warms an empty concession office while occupied flats freeze. Merek's repair crew can redirect it, if they can protect the next shift from inheriting the debt.

name: Sable Ren
title: Listening Courts access keeper
dialogue: The court won silence from its advertisements and lost its flood warning with them. Sable is building a warning that can be seen and felt without turning every home into a loudspeaker.

name: Ivo Pell
title: Last Connection platform steward
dialogue: The night connection is listed as empty because its cleaners and carers travel on service passes. Ivo has one shift to make the people who keep the towers alive visible to the timetable.
